items.summary: Google SecOpsFeatureBasic Mode searchThis feature is in public preview. The SIEM Search page now provides two search-execution modes: Basic Mode and Advanced Mode. Basic Mode (the default option) uses a streamlined, fast-path execution pipeline that bypasses secondary enrichment steps during search execution. This approach reduces end-to-end search wait times while preserving full data fidelity and query syntax parity. Advanced Mode is equivalent to the previous search experience.For more information, see Choose the search-execution mode and Understand the search-execution modes.
